requirement: Radiator sits square on lower pads/saddles with no hose tension, no tank twist, and both sides supported.
evidence: Wide photo from front and side with ruler/tape visible.

requirement: Condenser fits in front of radiator with at least 10-15 mm air gap and no grille/bonnet-latch conflict.
evidence: Side photo showing grille-to-condenser and condenser-to-radiator depth.

requirement: Optional pusher fan clears grille and mounts to frame/fan hoop, not through condenser or radiator fins.
evidence: Fan mounted photo and rear clearance photo.

requirement: Receiver-drier mounts vertical on a side bracket and leaves hose bend radius for condenser outlet and liquid line to firewall/TXV.
evidence: Drier mock-up photo with hose/fitting direction marked.

requirement: Existing Sanden-type compressor passes 12V clutch, pulley alignment, leak, oil/refrigerant, and port-style checks.
evidence: Close photos of compressor label/head ports plus A/C shop leak/oil note.

requirement: Final radiator and condenser tab holes are transferred from real parts with rubber washers installed.
evidence: Close photos of tab transfer marks and rubber stack.

requirement: All welded/drilled steel is deburred, test-fitted, and corrosion-prepped before primer/Raptor.
evidence: Bare-metal finished frame photos before coating.

requirement: Engine fan/shroud, belts, upper/lower hoses, A/C hoses, grille, bonnet, and service removal clearance all pass after final tightening.
evidence: Installed stack photos plus hand-shake/running clearance video.

requirement: A/C pressure protection switch is wired and verified before compressor is allowed to run charged.
evidence: Electrical test note or video showing clutch cutout/request logic.

requirement: Cooling system pressure test, warm idle leak check, and A/C condenser fan/pressure behavior are validated after assembly.
evidence: Pressure-test photo/video and warm running check.
